task_fulfillment.rationale: Strong negotiation structure, sincere engagement, levers, BATNA and exit diplomacy are present. Material corrections are required before executive use: continuity is not demonstrated through initial stock and transport lead time; the full plastics mould-out lacks a validated capacity plan; partial-bridge remedies do not quantify or reliably close the gap. Unconfirmed unit conversion, ramp readiness and inclusion of tool transit in development time underpin committed dates. Advance-payment offers also conflict with the payment red line. Required factual statements are incomplete, and page count remains unverified.
